narrative:
Hoshi leverages upon the new capabilities of the Commonwealth of Peoples.
    Hoshi visualises real estate service performance as a colour coded service rating, with internally consistent comparisons across a global domain.
    Larger red icons indicate expensive services that are relatively poor performing.
    Green icons indicate leading service performance.
    A Hoshi user can quickly establish which services require focussed capital investment in performance improvement and, once implemented, can validate the result.
